scope: Evaluation protocol for user-approved ChemGPT4.7M SELFIES LM/REINFORCE course project; review only

tasks: Fexofenadine MPO, GuacaMol v2, exploratory benchmark because earlier GRU already explored it
Osimertinib MPO, GuacaMol v2, final task only if no results used for tuning
proposed_protocol.time_cap: Freeze using dev throughput before final task results; 60/180min provisional candidates, not measured demands
proposed_protocol.primary_metric: Normalized trapezoid Top10 MPO AUC on uniform100-call grid; exact definition recorded
secondary: raw percomponent and strict joint feasibility
key_caveats: two tasks share correlated target definitions, not broad generalization
MPO>=0.8 is not strict joint feasibility
global-cache reuse never exempts perrun novel logical evaluation budget
duplicate sampled trajectories remain in on-policy loss using cached rewards
Fexofenadine cannot be called new blind test after oldGRU exploration
do not pick best test checkpoint or seed
no promise of RL or KL improvement
